objectives.text: Describe atomicity, consistency, isolation and durability by what you can observe in the database
Turn auto-commit off and end a multi-statement change with commit, or with rollback when any statement fails
Predict what another session sees before and after a transaction commits or rolls back

minutes.basis: New-course rule in authoring/docs/tools/validators.md (Reading time, T14). modeledP50 9.37 is the frozen estimator (authoring/tools/timing/estimate_reading.py, sha256 0deca96bf5e367aeae51a82abdbd4b6ce0d0289ecc9868c9eff3701016edf96f) P50 on the authored artifact.html bytes (853 words, 24 code lines, interactions {"predict":1,"confidence":2,"explore":1,"terminal_step":3,"mcq":1}). modeledWorstPath 11.04 = P50 plus 1.67 minutes for the worst required route: the apply question answered wrong once (a second 45 s attempt plus 15 s reading the retry feedback, 1.0 min), one failed editor check fixed from its Problems note (20 s) one extra timeline scenario read (10 s) and one missed session-2 prediction rerun (10 s). budget = aboutLabel = ceil(max(9.37, 11.04)) = 12, within the 15-minute cap. The module's five pages are budgeted inside the F23 Build block (see authoring/evidence/sql-jdbc-foundations/jdbc-data-access/module-plan.md).
